subject.title: feat(telegram): handle unknown groups with warn or leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in Telegram unknown-group warn/leave config, and if so should it be implemented as one shared authorization action path for normal messages and native slash commands?
rationale: The PR adds new user-facing config and a security-sensitive `leaveChat` side effect, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security semantics even though the current patch also has fixable bugs.

options.title: Revise the opt-in gate
options.body: Accept the direction only after the PR shares one precise unknown-group action path across messages and commands, fixes topic params, updates docs/tests, and provides real Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep deny-only behavior
options.body: Decline warn/leave config for now and keep current fail-closed deny/log or static-command-denial behavior as the supported Telegram posture.

options.title: Fold into broader group security work
options.body: Defer this narrow auto-leave feature into the broader group pairing, owner notification, and audit direction tracked by related issues.

recommendation.title: Revise the opt-in gate
recommendation.body: Accept the direction only after the PR shares one precise unknown-group action path across messages and commands, fixes topic params, updates docs/tests, and provides real Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current inspected Telegram authorization and handler surfaces most closely trace to recent `steipete` work, and the product/security decision is in that boundary.
